memories.content: fast-edit.ts in pi-standard-tools is intentionally a lightweight reimplementation of pi-snap-edit, not a wrapper. It omits fuzzy close-line-match diagnostics, substitute_edit, per-op diff reporting, custom TUI render results, and parseable error recovery that pi-snap-edit provides. To improve UX maintainability, consider either depending on pi-snap-edit directly or porting its fuzzy.ts, edit-error.ts parse function, and substitute-edit logic into fast-edit.ts.
